name: Progresso Traditional Chicken & Wild Rice Soup (Gentle Broth)
whyItWorks: Tender white meat chicken, wild and white rice, celery, and carrots in a golden chicken broth. Certified gluten-free, dairy-free, and contains only 1g fiber per cup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat in a saucepan over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until warm. A reliable canned soup for quick lunches.
